The tactical term combines move, OC, range, deep-strike, scout, infiltrator, sticky-objective — calibrated by grid search on a held-out 'known fair' anchor set. See `TacticalWeights` docstring.
method: Phase 2 combat solve + multiplicative tactical-utility overlay (anchor-relative log-shift)
